ios.guide.body:
iOS doesn't let apps draw a floating button over other apps, so TScreen uses the built-in Shortcuts app together with the system AssistiveTouch button.

STEP 1 — Create the shortcut
1. Open TScreen at least once (so iOS registers the "Translate with TScreen" action).
2. Open the Shortcuts app (pink–purple squares icon; reinstall it free from the App Store if deleted).
3. Shortcuts tab → tap + in the top-right corner.
4. Tap the name at the top → Rename → enter "TScreen translate screen".
5. Tap "Add Action", type "Take Screenshot" → choose Take Screenshot.
6. Type "TScreen" in the search field at the bottom → choose "Translate with TScreen". The action reads "Translate [Screenshot] with TScreen". If the middle field is not Screenshot: LONG-PRESS it (a normal tap opens the file picker) → Select Variable → tap the Take Screenshot action above. Don't use "Choose" (it opens the file picker).
7. Type "Quick Look" → choose Quick Look.
8. Tap Done. Run the shortcut once and allow any permission prompts.

STEP 2 — Assign it to the AssistiveTouch button
1. Settings → Accessibility → Touch → AssistiveTouch → turn on.
2. Under "Custom Actions" → Single-Tap → scroll to Shortcuts → choose "TScreen translate screen".
3. Optionally lower "Idle Opacity" so the button covers less content.

STEP 3 — Translation settings (Settings tab in this app)
• Choose an engine: Apple Translation (free, offline) or Claude/OpenAI (API key required).
• Choose the target language.
• Apple Translation: download language packs first in Settings → General → Language & Region → Translation Languages.

USAGE
In any app, tap the floating button: the screen is captured, translated and shown in Quick Look. Pinch to zoom, swipe down or tap Done to close, tap Share to save the image.

EXTRA TRIGGERS (optional)
• Back Tap: Settings → Accessibility → Touch → Back Tap → Double Tap → choose the shortcut.
• Action button (iPhone 15 Pro and later): Settings → Action Button → Shortcut → choose the shortcut.

TROUBLESHOOTING
• "Translate with TScreen" not listed: open TScreen once and try again, or restart the iPhone.
• Timeout error: try another engine or a faster model.
• Apple Translation reports a missing language: download it as in Step 3.
settings.baseURLHelp:
Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible API, ending in /v1. The app appends /chat/completions.
Example: %@
settings.privacyWarning: Text recognized in the captured area will be sent to %@'s servers. Avoid capturing passwords, OTP codes or sensitive data. The image itself is not sent.
settings.reasoningEffort: Reasoning effort (leave empty if the model doesn't support it)
settings.saveHistory: Save translation history (up to %d items, stored on this Mac only)
status.noText: No text found in the captured area.
